text: Writer Ben Rolf, his wife Marian and their twelve-year-old son Davey [rent a remote, shabby mansion for the summer|trigger|making a new home] at a bargain price, on one condition: they must leave meals for the owners' elderly mother behind her locked upstairs door. Marian, [slowly taken over by the house|threat|being taken over], tends its sitting room full of [framed portraits of former occupants|images|pictures, screens and recordings]. With every injury and illness, dead flowers bloom and new shingles appear, as if the house [feeds on the family's strength|rules|it must feed].
